_comment: A card that exists only for tests/unit/triggers/test_play_from_exile_trigger.py. Never part of a deck list; loaded by the test registry fixture alongside data/cards/. `t_exile_player` is Klaw, Master of Sound's 'Whenever you play a card from exile' -- one printed line, two abilities (a spell is cast, a land is played), each with `from_zones: ["exile"]`. It draws rather than gaining indestructible so a test can count the firings.
